companyMode.title: Company Agents Mode
companyMode.description: Create a team of AI agents with distinct roles to collaborate on your projects. Each agent can use a different AI model. The Master orchestrates, subordinates execute.

agentActions.deleteConfirm: Delete agent '{{role}}'? It will be aborted if running and removed from the panel.

memory.hint: What new agents are born knowing — curate, fix or delete.
company.operationalRules.label: Operational rules
company.operationalRules.placeholder: Mandatory rules for this session — e.g. validate all frontend↔backend contracts; never map/normalize backend enums locally; dev must not use preview (only QA does); run self_review before delivering. Paste your canonical rules here.
company.operationalRules.sidebarHint: Injected verbatim into the master and every subordinate prompt at start, spawn and resume. New agents pick it up immediately; the running master on its next reestablish.
transcript.empty: No inter-agent messages on this session yet.

services.external.dockerfileRequired: Dockerfile or Containerfile with EXPOSE required
services.external.pickOrPath: Pick an existing project or enter an absolute path.
services.external.removeConfirm: Remove microservice '{{serviceId}}'? The container/link will be removed, but the project files are preserved.
services.attached.title: Attach container
services.attached.notice: The platform will only inspect this container. Start, stop, pause, restart and delete must be done from your host (podman/docker) — clicking remove here just unlinks the row.
services.attached.refRequired: Container ID or name is required.
services.attached.removeConfirm: Detach '{{serviceId}}'? The link will be removed but the container will keep running outside the platform.
template.name: Name
template.masterRequired: At least one role must be named "master".
template.noTemplates: No templates yet. Create one to define reusable agent teams.
role.name: Role name
role.availableMcpsHint: Subordinates unlock each pack on demand via expand_toolset(tier: "<id>"). Configure servers in Admin → MCP Servers.
role.systemPromptPlaceholder: Custom system prompt override. Use ${{PROJECT_NAME}}, ${{SESSION_ID}}, ${{USER_INPUT}}, ${{OS}}, ${{TIMESTAMP}} as template variables.
role.removeConfirm: Remove the '{{role}}' role from this session?
role.removeConfirmActive: The '{{role}}' role still has a live agent. Remove the role anyway? The running agent keeps going.
role.thinking.title: Extended thinking
role.thinking.description: Enables deep reasoning for subordinates of this role on providers that support it (Anthropic, Gemini). Costs extra tokens — use for genuinely hard tasks. Providers that don't support it ignore the flag silently.
indexed.hint: Click a row to see summary + analysis
docs.noDocs: No docs yet. Ask the agents to document something — the `docs_write` tool creates files under `docs/` and they appear here.
docs.selectDoc: Select a document on the left, or ask the agents to write one.
env.title: Shared environment variables
env.description: Injected as container env + written to /app/.env in every microservice of this session. Live edits sync to running containers; dev-servers pick them up on next file-watch tick.
env.noEnvVars: No env vars yet. Add one below — or have the agent call env_set from the sandbox.
env.confirmDelete: Delete env var '{{key}}'? This affects every microservice in this session.
databases.title: Databases
databases.description: Register Postgres, MySQL, Supabase or Neon instances. Connection strings are persisted as shared env vars (same pipeline as the Env tab) and exposed to the agent via db_list, db_schema, db_query.
databases.noDatabases: No databases yet. Click Add database to register one.
databases.confirmDelete1:
Delete database '{{label}}'?

Press OK to also remove its env vars. Press Cancel to keep the env vars (the agent might still reference them).
databases.addDatabaseModalDesc: Credentials are saved as session env vars (is_secret=true for passwords / keys). The first DB of each provider uses unprefixed env names; additional ones get a _LABEL suffix so they never collide.
databases.label: Label
databases.willBePrimary: Will be the primary DB of this provider (unprefixed env names).
databases.existingPrimary: An existing {{provider}} is primary — this one will use suffixed env names.
databases.labelExists: Label '{{label}}' already exists in this session.
archived.emptyHint: Archives appear here when you reset the session. Each reset creates a snapshot with all conversations and agents at that moment.
pipelines.empty: No pipelines yet. Click 'Create pipeline' to define one.
pipelines.confirmDelete: Delete pipeline "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
pipelines.initialInputPlaceholder: Initial input — becomes {{initial_input}} in the start node template.
pipelines.selectExecution: Select an execution to see its timeline.
pipelines.node.title: Node
pipelines.node.label: Label
pipelines.node.taskHelp: Use {{initial_input}}, {{previous_output}} or {{vars.<nodeId>.output}} to pull values from earlier stages.
pipelines.node.kanbanColumnTarget: Move card to column on completion
pipelines.node.maxAttemptsHelp: Cap on how many times this node can run within a single execution (cycles count too).
pipelines.node.kindAgentHelp: Standard execution stage — runs as a subagent with the parent's tool registry.
pipelines.node.kindValidateHelp: Decision-only stage — calls submit_verdict({pass|fail|review}) once, then stops. branch mode is locked to pass-fail.
pipelines.node.validatorPromptPlaceholde: Pass when the upstream output mentions tests; fail otherwise; review on doubt.
pipelines.node.validatorPromptHelp: Free-text criteria fed to the validator subagent. Be specific — the verdict's `reason` field references this.
pipelines.node.validatorToolsHelp: Read-only tools the validator may call before submitting its verdict. Empty = pure inference on the upstream output.
pipelines.node.requiresConfirmationToggl: Pause for human approval after this stage
pipelines.node.requiresConfirmationHelp: When enabled, the executor pauses after this node completes. The dashboard surfaces an Approve button before advancing to the next stage.
pipelines.node.modelOverrideHelp: Leave blank to inherit the chat session's provider/model. Useful when validators run on a cheaper model than executors.
pipelines.fieldNameTip: Display name shown in the chat picker.
pipelines.fieldDescriptionTip: Short summary surfaced under the pipeline name in the picker.
pipelines.help.title: Building a pipeline
pipelines.help.tipTemplates: Click a template on the left to add a stage.
pipelines.help.tipDrag: Drag from a handle to wire two stages together.
pipelines.help.tipValidator: Validators have three output handles (pass/fail/review). Pull from the matching one.
pipelines.help.tipEdit: Click a stage or wire to open the editor on the right.
pipelines.help.tipBoxSelect: Drag on empty canvas to box-select; Space + drag (or middle/right button) to pan.
pipelines.help.tipDelete: Delete or Backspace removes the selected stage(s) and wire(s).
pipelines.addNodeTip: Add a blank stage you can edit afterwards.
pipelines.empty.title: Empty canvas
pipelines.empty.body: Click a template on the left to add your first stage, or drag handles between nodes to wire them together.
pipelines.templates.heading: Templates
pipelines.templates.subheading: Click to add a pre-configured stage
pipelines.templates.items.investigate.de: Read-write agent that scopes the request and produces an actionable summary for the next stage.
pipelines.templates.items.gather-context: Walks the project and lists the relevant files plus a short relevance note for each.
pipelines.templates.items.implement.desc: Agent stage that performs the change end-to-end and runs tests/build/lint when relevant.
pipelines.templates.items.refactor.label: Refactor
pipelines.templates.items.refactor.descr: Performs a refactor preserving external behavior; doesn't introduce features.
pipelines.templates.items.validate-outpu: Generic validator: pass when the upstream output is concrete and on-topic, fail when vague.
pipelines.templates.items.qa-gate.label: QA gate
pipelines.templates.items.qa-gate.descri: Validator with read-only access to git diff/status — passes only when tests/build/lint were verified.
pipelines.templates.items.human-review.d: Pauses the pipeline for explicit human approval before advancing.
pipelines.templates.items.summarize.desc: Produces a concise user-facing summary of the prior stage.
pipelines.templates.items.write-changelo: Writes a one-paragraph changelog entry from the prior stage.
pipelines.templates.items.manual-checkpo: Logs a marker and pauses for explicit approval — useful between long phases.
pipelines.templates.items.classify.label: Classify
pipelines.templates.items.classify.descr: Asks the model to emit PASS / FAIL / REVIEW so a pass-fail edge can route the run.
pipelines.node.idTip: Stable identifier used by edges. Auto-generated; cannot change.
pipelines.node.labelTip: Human-friendly name shown in the canvas card.
pipelines.node.kindTip: Agent: runs as a subagent with tools. Validator: decision-only, calls submit_verdict and stops.
pipelines.node.roleTip: Hint shown in logs and useful when the same project has multiple stages — does not affect the model.
pipelines.node.taskTemplateTip: Prompt sent to the stage. {{initial_input}} = user input, {{previous_output}} = previous stage output, {{vars.<id>.output}} = explicit prior stage.
pipelines.node.modelOverrideTip: Optional. Empty = inherit chat session. Useful to run validators on a cheaper model than executors.
pipelines.node.deleteTip: Remove this stage and any wires touching it.
pipelines.edge.title: Edge
pipelines.edge.kindTip: linear: always advance. pass-fail: route by validator verdict. by-tag: kanban tag. by-text-match: regex over agent output.
pipelines.edge.onReviewHelp: 'review' is only valid when the from-node is a Validator.
pipelines.edge.patternHelp: Tested against the agent's final message. First matching edge wins.
inbox.empty: Inbox is empty for this filter.
inbox.confirmCancel: Cancel this inbox message? The sender unblocks with a cancellation note.
inbox.answerPlaceholder: Type the answer the target should send back…
fronts.new_dialog_description: Open a parallel work front in this session. The new front gets its own master and board, sharing the project and sandbox with the others.
fronts.confirm_archive: Archive front "{{label}}"? Its agents will stop and the tab disappears.
drive.selectFile: Select a file on the left to view it.
drive.empty: The drive is empty. Use Attach to upload a document, or let the agents write to it.
drive.pdfDownloadOnly: PDFs cannot be previewed inline — use the Download button.
drive.deleteFolder: Delete folder and all files inside
files.noProject: No project linked to the session.
git.pushUpToDate: Nothing to push — branch is in sync
agentModal.noMessages: No messages yet for this session.
masterBanner.finishedHint: Send a follow-up to start a new turn.
sessionStalled.title: Session stalled
sessionStalled.body: {{minutes}} min without progress. The master may be waiting on a blocked tool or a human reply.
sessionRecovered.tooltip: This session was paused by a server restart at {{at}}. Send a message to resume.
qa.noRunHint: When the QA agent starts a Playwright suite, results stream here in real time.
qa.diagnosticsIntro: When the QA agent starts a Playwright suite, results stream here in real time. Below: recent run state, reporter health, and endpoint configuration.
qa.watchdogHint: Hint: the reporter never POST'd events. Check that the agent called qa_start_run before npx playwright test, did NOT pass --reporter=… on the CLI, and that the container can reach {{endpoint}}.
qa.noRunsRecorded: No QA runs have ever been recorded for this session.
qa.watchdogCause: Each one started but never received reporter events. Consult the QA Playwright skill doc — common cause is --reporter=… on the CLI overriding playwright.config.ts.
qa.sandboxHint: QA artifacts cannot be inspected — provision the project sandbox first.
qa.reporterHealthyHint: tests/e2e/reporter.ts, global-setup.ts and playwright.config.ts match the v4.5 templates.
qa.driftConfigMissing: playwright.config.ts is missing — install it from the Restore QA config button or run `qa_start_run`.
qa.driftReporterEdited: tests/e2e/reporter.ts has been edited — streaming may be broken. Click "Restore QA config" to revert.
qa.driftGlobalSetupEdited: tests/e2e/global-setup.ts has been edited — preview cookie injection may be broken.
qa.endpointFallbackHint: MCP_PUBLIC_URL is not set on the host — the reporter targets the container-runtime loopback alias. If your sandbox cannot resolve host.docker.internal / host.containers.internal, set MCP_PUBLIC_URL on the server and re-run.
qa.openHtmlReportTitle: Open the full Playwright HTML report
qa.noRows: No individual test rows captured for this run.
qa.noRunsYet: No QA runs yet. The QA agent publishes results here as soon as it runs `npx playwright test`.
qa.urlRoutingDescription: How each microservice is addressed at three layers. The Chrome Service navigates to PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL_* via the http-api proxy with an HMAC cookie (auto-injected). Specs use relative paths (page.goto('/login')); the bundled playwright.config.ts wires the rest.
qa.noManagedUrls: No managed URLs found for this session yet — provision a sandbox first (and assign a role with the qa-playwright skill to populate the QA family).
